independence.privileged_database_evidence: Separate identity/custody corroboration only. Never passed as labels or inputs to loader or fit.
independence.sqlite_access: Only in-memory copies of original TRAIN database bytes, with query_only enabled; original files never opened for SQLite writes.

leakage_and_scope.censoring_not_random: All opaque-after-apply examples are masked; observed-only metrics cannot characterize this fault family.
leakage_and_scope.grouping: Keep all destinations, schema names, replicates, and same-episode transitions inside the same length/fault family.

source_semantics.ensure: Existing synchronous ensure executes optional stage then apply, sets last=ensure and returns; no goal check occurs inside ensure.
source_semantics.entry_features: Exact original 10 features sampled before fixed policy selected ensure; all have task complete bit zero.
source_semantics.invocation: Original trace omits operation ID; derived from pinned apply source task.id + colon + original view.index. Separately corroborated against retained TRAIN SQLite applied rows.
source_semantics.label: First subsequent non-null original actor inspect before a later mutation; whole-task completion differs from invocation-goal confirmation.
source_semantics.timing: at_ns is charged primitive-call entry before execution. First mutation entry to next read entry is a call-start gap, not ensure return duration, observation availability time, or skill completion latency.
source_semantics.unknown: All unavailable original actor readbacks remain null; later/physical oracle information does not fill them.
